code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def row_nonempty(i): return any(grid[i][j] != 0 for j in range(w))
    def col_nonempty(j): return any(grid[i][j] != 0 for i in range(h))
    def lattice(n, nonempty):
        start = next((i for i in range(n) if nonempty(i)), None)
        if start is None: return []
        length = 0
        while start + length < n and nonempty(start + length): length += 1
        pitch = length + 2
        return list(range(start + length // 2, n, pitch))
    rows, cols = lattice(h, row_nonempty), lattice(w, col_nonempty)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    centers = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols}
    from collections import Counter
    base = Counter(centers.values()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for color in set(centers.values()) - {base}:
        for r in rows:
            cs = [c for c in cols if centers[(r, c)] == color]
            if len(cs) >= 2:
                for c in range(min(cs), max(cs) + 1): out[r][c] = color
        for c in cols:
            rs = [r for r in rows if centers[(r, c)] == color]
            if len(rs) >= 2:
                for r in range(min(rs), max(rs) + 1): out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
